# bsitf.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

bsitf.sys and AsusBSItf.sys are ASUS BIOS Flash Driver naming variants distributed with the ASUS WinFlash utility. The 3.2.12.0 AsusBSItf.sys build exposes physical-memory reads through MmMapIoSpace (IOCTL 0x222804), contiguous kernel-memory allocation mapped to user mode through an MDL (IOCTL 0x222808), arbitrary I/O-port writes and reads (IOCTLs 0x222810 and 0x222818), and PCI configuration-space reads with BAR mapping (IOCTL 0x222814). Public research identifies this low-privilege interface as CVE-2024-33221 and demonstrates its use for privilege escalation, kernel code execution, or information disclosure. Earlier bsitf.sys builds tracked in this record additionally expose BIOS flash writes through IOCTL 0x22281C.
- **UUID**: 9905c737-83ad-4801-a573-8267f3aea924

- **Author**: Michael Haag

### Commands

```
sc.exe create bsitf binPath=C:\windows\temp\bsitf.sys type=kernel &amp;&amp; sc.exe start bsitf
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Elevate privileges | User | Windows 10 |
